paragraphs.text: Cadoras Damellawar is a first-year elf student from Quandrix College at Strixhaven University. A spirited and eccentric personality on campus, Cadoras is known for his jolly demeanor, whimsical habits, and his deep enthusiasm for both art and imaginative play.

Cadoras is a self-taught sculptor whose magical artworks often feature intricate fractal patterns, earning him a place in the university's Distinguished Society of Fine Artists. Despite lacking formal training, his sculptures are widely admired, particularly for their complexity and creativity. Outside the studio, Cadoras is an avid participant in the Live-Action Roleplaying Guild, where he takes great joy in enacting fantasy adventures — always as an archer, thanks to a costly prop bow he's determined to get his money's worth from.

A lover of the absurd, Cadoras often leaves his peers laughing at his latest antics or peculiar habits, such as his tendency to consume an entire jar of pickled onions and drink the brine in one sitting. Though he has no campus job, his presence is felt in the social and extracurricular life of Strixhaven, where his popularity in roleplaying circles can benefit — or hinder — those around him. For those he considers friends, other guild members will happily share knowledge on certain types of creatures. But if he holds a grudge, a disliked student's name might end up attached to the most infamous monsters in their stories.
